metadata.provenance: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP), version 20250930 (2021 PPP), Bangladesh national survey-year estimates.
metadata.method: Survey-year poverty headcount at the $4.20/day line (2021 PPP), fill_gaps=false. Cross-country panel: each country surveys on its own calendar, so the survey years differ between countries and are sparse.
metadata.caveat: Survey-year points on different national calendars; read as trajectories, not a same-year comparison. The India-vs-Asia divergence article covers this in depth.
